quest.title: The Ancient Azure Stars
quest.description: Upon hearing the voices deep within her heart, Mona becomes lost in some old memories. She has a unique understanding of Astrology and believes in fate regardless of what others think. With this belief in her heart, she leads everyone to explore the mirage...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

talks.objective: Follow the hint and explore the area
Return to the mirage and use the shard
Find the destination of the mirage maze
Find the destination of the mirage maze

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, we're back again!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: So uh, Mona, is that adventurer... dead now?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: That was the only time I ever saw him. And that was more than three years ago, which means... he's no longer alive.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But isn't there still a chance that he's alive? You know, like maybe you just made a mistake?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But that's not fair.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: You can't call it divination if you reject anything bad and believe the good unreservedly. That's just self-deception.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Of course, casually performing divination for fun might be a different matter, but in my field of expertise, there's no room for lies.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: To contradict my own reading would be a blasphemy against astrology.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Cruel, but truthful. Such is fate.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: I don't usually say things like this, but while we're on the topic, I really hope you don't confuse astrology with those fortune stick peddlers that you see along the streets.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Astrology does not exist to please. We astrologists are here to verify and witness the truths of this world.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Which is why astrology is a disdained profession! It is a mighty art, but unfortunately one that annoys people nonetheless.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Why dost thou protest so much, Lady Megistus? Thou seemst not to be the sort with whom one would be loathe to be associated.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: What mein Fräulein means is that she's glad to be friends with you.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: No! That was not what I said!

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Whatever has gotten into you, Oz! You misinterpret my utterances with an increasingly alarming frequency!

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Oh my, why could that be? Perhaps I have been concerned that mein Fräulein could offend her friends and have been attempting to soften her words?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Although you're the only astrologist I know, you've left an awesome impression on me. You're not annoying at all!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Those who go snooping around for secrets, yet ignore whatever they don't wanna hear? They're the ones who should reflect on themselves. Knowing your fate doesn't come cheap.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: If one could simply avoid fate with just a few words, no one would have to endure the pain of parting. Mona, don't take others' comments to heart.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Follow your heart and never forget what's right.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: I—I don't need comforting, thank you very much! I'm very tough, you know!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then why are your ears red?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Oh, uh...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Well, then... Umm...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Th—Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: What dost thou say? Speak up, and offer your highest reverence and blessings to the Prinzessin.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Okay, okay, Your Highness... Instead of making a scene, why don't you go collect the other fragments in the new location reflected by the pool? We can't enter the mirage without 'em.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Mein Fräulein, you are the only one with eyes sharp enough to locate the secrets.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: If that's the case, very well, I shall proceed to the beach...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Let's go, Mona.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Oh, okay! Coming!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: ...Haha.
